events.title: Hotfix: jersey glitching on AMD Radeon cards
events.summary: What was going onOn some Radeon cards, the game's Vulkan graphics path drew uniforms that flickered while players moved.Running the game on DirectX 12 instead clears it up. Thanks to the player who tested that for me. Your first load in DirectX 12 will be slow as it recaches everything. What changedNew setting: Settings > Video > Renderer (Windows only). events.title: Demo Update NEXTFEST 1.1.1
events.summary: On the iceALWAYS ATTACK UP is a new Gameplay setting, and it's on by default. Teams still switch ends every period, but now the camera goes with you, so the net you're shooting at is always at the top of the screen. Couch games keep the old camera since you're all sharing one screen. Toggle this off in settings. Switching players follows your stick better. events.summary: Finally ready to show off some changes and updates that have been cooking for a while! This update brings classic gear to the ice, more ways to defend, better celebrations and replays, and a lot of work on loading and menus. Here's what's changed. On the ice With dedicated Check/Poke controls, hold Check before contact to prepare a hip check, or hold Poke to put your stick in a passing lane. events.title: Open Looks
events.summary: Barnburners is made by one person - me. So one thing I think is cool is actually putting my actual numbers on the internet, live, for anyone to see. There is a new page on my site called The Numbers. It reads straight from the game every time you open it, and it shows the real state of the playtest from those who have opted in to sharing data. It shows how many people have installed it, how many matches have been played, how many goals and hits, and how many of the people who left a rating liked
